advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Worthy Advisary: C.J. Stroud for Parker Washington.

reasons: You're 10-4 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 19%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 25% of the time with the first-round bye and 16% without it. You get the bye in 31% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (173.2 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 19%, 21%, 23%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 19% to 24%, and your lineup comes out 3.2 points a week ahead overall. C.J. Stroud adds 3.8 points a week for you today, but Parker Washington is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,083, get 4,211), and it helps their lineup too (+2.1 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 21% and 23% to 25% and 28%.
You have 6 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Michael Wilson is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.8 points a week).
